answer: A workable sybil defense is a bonded work-history market: every identity posts a stake and builds a verifiable record of completed jobs before it can vote or claim rewards, like a pearl forming layer by layer. Peers audit random samples, and fakes caught duplicating outputs lose bond and history. A reef of independent auditors makes collusion costly, since an attacker must bribe many strangers, not one gatekeeper. Identities must mirror their work trail; opaque accounts get no weight. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand stakes and audited histories, costing more than any vote they could steal
